entries.source: Melee Attack. Lose all adrenaline. If it hits, this attack will result in a critical hit and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked.
entries.text: 近身攻擊技能。失去所有怒氣。若此攻擊命中，必定造成致命一擊，並結束目標正在使用的態勢。此攻擊無法被格擋。
